claims.evidence: SampleInformation lists yanliu_Y151023_002_SW..037_SW as "SWATH-MS-ProteinTurnover: <T1DS|T2N>_rep<1-3>_<0|1|4|8|14|24>hr"; each has a deposited .wiff (+ .wiff.scan) in the PRIDE file list. The .wiff is the vendor RAW; .wiff.scan is its companion data file.

claims.location: source name / characteristics[individual] / characteristics[biological replicate] / characteristics[sampling time] rows 1-72
claims.value: per run from SampleInformation (e.g. Y151023_002 = T1DS rep1 0 hour)
claims.evidence: Run sheet gives twin, replicate and pulse time for every run. Paper Methods: "The three replicates of T1DS and T2N samples were used ... six time points (0, 1, 4, 8, 14, and 24 h)"; Results: pSILAC "to both T1DS and T2N (three experimental replicates each)". SI Fig 1: an experimental replicate is "the independent whole-process replicate starting from two separated dishes". Hence rep1-3 = separate dishes -> biological replicate 1-3 within each (disease, time) group (campaign rule 3).

claims.value: SILAC light = pre-existing proteins; SILAC heavy = newly synthesized proteins (two rows per run, same culture)
claims.evidence: Methods: cells grown in light SILAC medium, at t0 switched to heavy medium (13C6 15N2 Lys, 13C6 15N4 Arg); RIA = light/(light+heavy) models loss of the light (old) protein. OpenSWATH output contains light and heavy (UniMod:259 K / UniMod:267 R) precursors for each peptide in each run. Data check: H/(L+H) of summed paired intensities rises with the run sheet time: 0 h 0.111-0.126, 1 h 0.123-0.150, 4 h 0.191-0.219, 8 h 0.282-0.307, 14 h 0.380-0.408, 24 h 0.494-0.524 (SI Fig 7 reports ~50-52% heavy at 24 h). At 0 h the heavy row is a background/interference channel (no label yet), kept as in precedent PXD006015/PXD028934.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M variable; Label:13C(6)15N(2) K (UNIMOD:259) variable; Label:13C(6)15N(4) R (UNIMOD:267) variable
claims.evidence: Methods (pSILAC SWATH analysis): library search "Oxidation at methionine ... variable ... carbamidomethylation at cysteine ... fixed"; light and heavy assays generated by spectrast2tsv (TraML name R10K8). OpenSWATH FullPeptideName shows K(UniMod:259), R(UniMod:267). Paper: heavy L-lysine (13C6 15N2), arginine (13C6 15N4). MT=Variable per campaign rule 11.

Methods "SWATH mass spectrometry ... 64 variable wide precursor ion windows"; wiff header: SWATHMethod, acquisition method YL_SWATH64w_2ul_300nlmin_105min.dam, SWATH Exp 1-64 table. PRIDE:0000447 SWATH MS (OLS) is a DIA descendant licensed by dia-acquisition.

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE (campaign = SILAC): only the 36 pulsed-SILAC SWATH runs (yanliu_Y151023_002_SW..037_SW.wiff) are annotated. Not annotated, because they are not SILAC-multiplexed: 56 label-free steady-state SWATH runs (12 twin runs yanliu_Y141216_0xx_SWa, 44 unrelated-individual runs yanliu_Y150223_0xx_SW incl. 012a_SW), 34 light-only DDA library runs (YANLIU_J140818_*, YANLIU_Y141216_0xx odd, YANLIU_Y150109_*, YANLIU_Y151023_038/039, YANLIU_Y151028_001-004 = pSILAC t0 light shotgun) and 14 dimethyl-labelled Q Exactive Plus raws (20150611_PB_*, 20150612_PB_YL_*). Run-sheet wiff names are matched case-insensitively (PRIDE spells them yanliu_*). These can be annotated in separate label-free/dimethyl SDRFs.

The Orbitrap Elite pSILAC comparison runs (MaxQuant SILAC search, Methods) are not in the deposit; no MaxQuant summary.txt exists. SILAC multiplicity (rule 14) was verified instead from the deposited OpenSWATH output (paired light/heavy precursors with UniMod:259/267 in every run).
Heavy share per run computed from a 144 x 1 MB sample of the 1.7 GB feature_alignment file (about 1200-1700 light/heavy pairs per run), not the full file.
Precursor/fragment tolerances not available: OpenSWATH extraction settings are not reported.

Biological replicate: the paper calls the three pSILAC replicates "experimental replicates" from separate dishes of split aliquots of one fibroblast stock per twin; numbered 1-3 within each (disease, time) group. Whether rep k at different times shares a dish lineage is not stated.
Age 16W is gestational age (16 fetal weeks), written in the only unit the pattern allows.
techsdrf not installable; instrument/method verified from one wiff header (Y151023_002) only; all pSILAC wiffs share size 13172736 bytes (002: 13168640) consistent with one method.
